relations.quote: Each algorithm in the chain computes its transforms by the [Discrete Fourier transform and butterflies](dft-fft.md), evaluating its coefficient lists at roots of unity in a suitable ring.
The chain's cost is measured against the [The n log n optimality conjecture](nlogn-conjecture.md).

symbols.name: padded length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in each zero-padded list, a power of two at least $2q-1$.
symbols.quote: Pad both lists with zeros to a power of two length $S \ge 2q-1$, so that $S$ is the number of entries in each padded list.
